constraints: Exact file refs and rebuilt-index digest bind the tools-index-declarations-and-selftests-v1 scope; this is not a full-repository byte snapshot.
Refresh uses the same sealed request time and appends only when the scoped source-state digest changes.
Reads the promotion ladder, tools index, manifests, contracts, discovered selftests, and derived entry/readme/discovery state; retains no raw source or machine paths.
Only detects missing, invalid, or source-digest-stale tools-index.json; it does not claim general code-quality judgment.
The only supported candidate is one detached tools-index.json under a disjoint shadow-state root.
Plan binds expected current digest, exact replacement digest and bytes, summaries, and tool-id additions/removals.
Source is re-observed before and after materialization and again before preview; scoped drift blocks reuse.
Direct-child iteration-NNN roots are exclusive-created, contiguous, digest-checked, and never repaired in place.
Preview opens only when current scoped source, deterministic plan, generator refs, and candidate refs still match.
Workshop source, shadow parent, and source/output/evidence roots are canonicalized and physically disjoint; aliases are rejected.
The allowlisted adapter has no source writer; pre/post source digests and adversarial tests verify no write-back in this bounded recipe.
All lifecycle claims remain false and authority NONE; the service exposes no installation or integration operation.
Trusted loopback shell contains no script and serves the candidate as inert JSON; candidate processes and child processes are zero.
